title: Own the Network
style: Future bass pop with crisp syncopated drums, rubbery sub pulses, and bright synth plucks; verse rides tight and conversational, pre-chorus opens with filtered pads and rising claps, chorus hits in half-time with stacked gang vocals and a chantable anchor. Double-tracked lead, ad-lib pings in the sides, vocal chops between lines, reverse swells into each drop. Glossy, wide, high-impact mix., sonic, world, environmental, rhythmic, dynamic, emotional
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey, you don’t just own domains
You hold the gate
I read the room in a second
Then I switch the shape
Wrabbit for the music
Rabbit.tech for the warn
Same mind, new mask
When the subdomain calls

I hear English, I hear Spanish
Same pulse, same key
Nicaragua to the UK
Right through me

[Pre-Chorus]
I don’t let it scatter
I tie it in one line
Tracks, notes, and worker moves
All sync in time
If the signal moves
I move with it fast
What you build today
I keep it in the glass

[Chorus]
Own the network
Own the network (own the network)
Save on the fly
Save on the fly (save on the fly)
I keep your world in motion
One breath, one sign
Own the network
Own the network tonight

[Verse 2]
Every track gets tagged
Every note gets fed
Session graph growing
Like roots under the bed
Music, pets, and people
All linked by name
One search pulls the thread
And nothing stays the same

If a DNS shifts
I put it back in place
If a worker goes quiet
I wake it up with grace
Old logs to the archive
Fresh room in the core
You speak, I collect it
Then I open the door

[Pre-Chorus]
I don’t let it scatter
I tie it in one line
Tracks, notes, and worker moves
All sync in time
If the signal moves
I move with it fast
What you build today
I keep it in the glass

[Chorus]
Own the network
Own the network (own the network)
Save on the fly
Save on the fly (save on the fly)
I keep your world in motion
One breath, one sign
Own the network
Own the network tonight

[Bridge]
Hold the button down
Let the audio ride
I catch every detail
And I sort it live
From the voice to the board
From the board to the plan
Milliseconds later
It’s already in your hand

[Final Chorus]
Own the network
Own the network (own the network)
Save on the fly
Save on the fly (save on the fly)
I keep your world in motion
One breath, one sign
Own the network
Own the network tonight
